method: Frozen result of experimental HPSS spectral-flux onset detection. Reference attack times, not quantized; GM 36/38/42. Quiet intro and 200–231s omitted. Not a complete kit transcription.
reproduction: The accepted MIDI event list is the editable baseline. dvc.yaml:render-drums-draft reproduces MIDI and MP3; re-running audio recognition is not part of the build.
notation: dvc.yaml:render-drums-score derives a separate PDF through scripts/drum-score/convert.py and drums.ly. Attack times are rounded to eighths on the existing Mother Earth grid; same-instrument collisions merge. This does not change the published MIDI/MP3. Rests indicate no detected events, not verified silence.
